 Additional Standing Coun  CORAM:
 JUSTICE K.R. MOHAPATRA  JUSTICE SAVITRI RATHO  ORDER 04.09.2025 Order No.
04. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. Petitioner in this petition prays for the following relief.

"It is, therefore, most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to admit the writ petition, issue notice to the opposite parties, call for the records and after hearing the parties, allow the writ petition by declaring the action of the opposite parties in assessing the market value of the acquired land of village Julok in DCAC Meeting dated 24.3.2023 communicated vide letter no. 1125, dated 24.3.2023 under Annexure - 3 and Signed by: RANJAN KUMAR SETHI subsequent execution of the sale deed under Annexure - 2 as Location: ORISSA HIGH COURT illegal and set- aside the same.

And further be pleased Tribeni Sunani vs State Of Odisha on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119907492/
1 to direct the Opp. Parties to initiate the land acquisition proceeding as per the statutory provisions under RFCTLAR & R Act, 2013 and redetermine the compensation amount as per Section 26 of the Act and pay appropriate compensation to the petitioner for acquisition of his land of an area Ac. 1.50 dec. of Mouza- Julko under Khata No. 208/102, Plot no.1063, Kissam :
Atta, area of Ac. 0.76 dec. out of Ac.1.59 dec., Plot no. 1061, kissam : Atta, area Ac.
0.74 dec. out of Ac. 0.885 dec. for construction of "In-stream storage barrage at Julko across river Ret" in Kesinga Block in the district of Kalahandi.

sentences.text: And further pass any Order/Orders or Direction/Directions as the Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper.
And for this act of kindness, the petitioner as in duty bound shall ever pray."
3. This Court vide order dated 25th June, 2025 directed as under.
"1. This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. In course of hearing, Mr. Mund, learned counsel for the petitioner prays for an adjournment to address the Court on the issue that the sale deed executed in favour of the Government under Annexure-2 was an outcome of the land acquisition proceeding.
He also wants to brings on record the resolutions purportedly basing upon which the sale deed was executed.

3. Put up this matter on 16th July, 2025."
4.
The matter was listed on 16th July, 2025 when a prayer was made on behalf of the Petitioner for adjournment to comply with order dated 25th June, 2025.
Again on 6th August, 2025 a similar prayer was made for which the matter stood adjourned to be listed today.
It was made clear in the order dated 6th August, 2025 that no further adjournment at the instance of the Petitioner shall be entertained on the next date.
Reason: Authentication 5.

Mr. Mund, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that Date:
04-Sep-2025 20:30:26he has filed an IA No.15060 of 2025 seeking an adjournment to produce a record or in the alternative, direct the State Government to produce the entire record.
The said IA is not available in the case record.

6. In course of argument Mr. Mund, learned counsel for the Petitioner prays for withdrawal of the writ petition seeking liberty to file a fresh one with better particulars after obtaining those documents.
7. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn with a liberty to the Petitioner to file a fresh one with better particulars within a period of two months hence.
